dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Lilly arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. During intake it was reported that Lilly nipped the handler. While in care, Lilly has been observed to be highly fearful, noted to be at the back of the kennel when handlers approach. She will continue to present as tense and trembling while out of kennel. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult-only home.
dog.name: Lilly
